key_insight: EBP improves online reinforcement learning by learning expert-like action priors directly from the replay buffer instead of relying on static offline demonstrations.
engineering_relevance: The method can boost sample efficiency and training stability for robotic and industrial control systems where high-quality expert data is limited or costly.
method: Q-CVAE generates high-value expert policy priors from online experience.
Expert Policy Guidance (EPG) selects actions from a generative support set to improve exploitation.
Policy Gradient Correction (PGC) aligns Q-guidance with expert supervision for stable updates.
evidence_signal: The paper reports experiments on Gym, PyBullet, and DMControl benchmarks, where EBP outperforms state-of-the-art online RL methods in sample efficiency and convergence stability.
watch_item: Performance may depend on the quality and coverage of the online replay buffer, and training a generative prior plus correction module adds implementation complexity.
